speaker: Pak Budi
text: Okay, let's start. Thanks everyone for joining. Today I want to cover the pricing page, the onboarding bug reports, and the investor demo next month.

speaker: Dion
text: Sounds good, Pak.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: First, pricing. We agreed with the board that we move to three tiers. Basic, Pro and Enterprise. The current page only shows one price and customers are confused.

speaker: Rina
text: So we drop the single plan completely?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Yes. The single plan becomes Basic. Rina, can you redesign the pricing page with the three tiers? Use the new brand colours from the Figma file Sari shared last week, and show both monthly and yearly prices with the yearly discount.

speaker: Rina
text: Okay. Do we keep the free plan?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Keep it, but don't show it on the pricing page. It stays on the signup flow only.

speaker: Rina
text: Got it. When do you need it?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Friday the 28th, so we can review before the demo.

speaker: Rina
text: Noted, Friday 28.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Second thing, onboarding. Sari, how many bug reports did we get this week?

speaker: Sari
text: Fourteen. Nine of them are the same issue, the verification email arrives late or not at all.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: That's bad. Dion, I need you to look at the email queue this week. Find the root cause, and if it is the provider, get me a comparison of two alternatives with pricing.

speaker: Dion
text: Okay. Can I pull Sari in for testing?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Yes, Sari helps with testing once the fix is ready.

speaker: Sari
text: Sure.

speaker: Dion
text: What's the deadline for the comparison?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Next Wednesday is fine, the fix itself as soon as possible.

speaker: Dion
text: Understood.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Last, the investor demo on December 5th. I decided we show the new pricing page and the fixed onboarding, nothing else. No new features.

speaker: Sari
text: Should I prepare the demo script?

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Yes please, Sari, a demo script with the two flows, send me a draft by Monday.

speaker: Sari
text: Will do.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: And someone needs to update the FAQ page for the new tiers, we'll figure out who later.

speaker: Rina
text: I can look at that if I have time after the pricing page.

speaker: Pak Budi
text: Let's see. Okay, that's everything. Thanks all.

speaker: Dion
text: Thanks Pak.
